  2. 02 Because you make me feel appreciated.
  3. 03 Because you make me feel lucky.
  4. 04 Because you make me feel like I have something beautiful to protect.
  5. 05 Because you make me want to become a better man.
  6. 06 Because you remind me that love is worth the effort.
  7. 07 Because you’re my favourite undecisive princess when it comes to food.

One Last Note

We see faces, hear voices, learn habits, and collect memories, but do we ever completely understand the soul of another person? I think loving you has made me realise that I don't necessarily need to understand every part of you to want to spend my life discovering it. I don't want to love only the parts of you that are easy to understand. I want to know the complicated parts, the quiet parts, the parts you struggle to explain, and still find reasons to stay.

— Fyodor Dostoevsky
